title: Italian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty, comforting Italian-inspired stew made with lentils, vegetables, and a hint of Peruvian spice. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lentils, diced tomatoes, Peruvian aji amarillo pepper, and Italian seasoning. Stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with crispy unique, if desired.
